A1MFG.V_LOT_A3 WHERE FAB ='N1A3' AND NENG_FLAG ='1' AND LOT_INV_STATE ='OnFloor' UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY ,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,MAINPD_ID,'WT' LOCATION_ ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LOT_ID,1,1) IN('N','1','2') THEN 'A12' WHEN SUBSTR(LOT_ID,1,1) IN('3','4') THEN 'A3' END LINE,LAST_CLAIM_DATE_TIME FROM WT.WT_LOT WHERE NENG_FLAG ='1' AND LOT_FINISHED_STATE IS NULL AND BANK_ID IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY ,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,MAINPD_ID,'WT' LOCATION_ ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(LOT_ID,1,1) IN('N','1','2') THEN 'A12' WHEN SUBSTR(LOT_ID,1,1) IN('3','4') THEN PWEB.V_CUTLINE_EXCLUDE_LOT WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' )A2 WHERE A1.LOT_ID = A2.LOT_ID )),OQC_MTD_WIP AS( SELECT PRODG1,LINE,SUM(REVENUE_QTY)OQC_MTD FROM( SELECT A.*,B.PRODG1,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE < LOT_ID,PRODSPEC_ID,WAFER_QTY,TO_CHAR(CLAIM_DATE_TIME-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE ,'A3'LINE FROM A1MFG.WT_MOVE_HISTORY_A3 WHERE TO_CHAR(CLAIM_DATE_TIME-7.5/24,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMM')AND OPE_NO = 'BankIn' AND NENG_FLAG ='1' ) A LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT A.PRODG1,A.LINE,A.REVENUE_DATE FROM PRODG1,LINE,SUM(MONTH_COMMIT_QTY)MONTH_COMMIT_QTY,SUM(REVENUE_COMMIT_QTY)REVENUE_COMMIT_QTY ,SUM(CASE WHEN LOCATION_ = 'WT' THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END)WT_WIP ,SUM(CASE WHEN LOCATION_ = 'WT' AND ,sum(REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST)REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,LINE,WAFER_QTY,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,COMMIT_DATE2,PRODG1,REVENUE_DATE,LOT_PROC_STATE,LOCATION_ ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(COMMIT_DATE2,1,6) <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMM') THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END MONTH_COMMIT_QTY ,CASE WHEN COMMIT_DATE2 <= REVENUE_DATE THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END REVENUE_COMMIT_QTY ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(NVL(FCST_DAY,'999999'),1,6) <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMM') THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END MONTH_OUTPUT_FCST ,CASE WHEN NVL(FCST_DAY,'99999999') < REVENUE_DATE THEN WAFER_QTY ELSE 0 END REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST FROM( SELECT A.*,B.COMMIT_DATE2,B.FCST_DAY,C.PRODG1,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.REVENUE_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYYMMDD')REVENUE_DATE FROM( SELECT ,OUTPUT_PLAN,REVENUE_GAP,OQC_MTD,MONTH_COMMIT_QTY,REVENUE_COMMIT_QTY,WT_WIP,WT_HOLD_WIP ,WT_HOLD_COUNT,MONTH_OUTPUT_FCST,REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST,OUTPUT_DIFF ,REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST - REVENUE_TARGET REVENUE_DIFF ,REVENUE_TARGET - OQC_MTD - WT_WIP REVENUE_WP_OUTPUT FROM( SELECT A.*,NVL(B.OQC_MTD,0)OQC_MTD,NVL(C.MONTH_COMMIT_QTY,0)+NVL(B.OQC_MTD,0) MONTH_COMMIT_QTY NVL(B.OQC_MTD,0) MONTH_OUTPUT_FCST ,CASE WHEN RECEIVE_MORE = '是' THEN NVL(C.REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST,0) + NVL(B.OQC_MTD,0) WHEN RECEIVE_MORE = '否' THEN LEAST(NVL(C.REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST,0) + NVL(B.OQC_MTD,0) ,REVENUE_TARGET) END REVENUE_OUTPUT_FCST ,NVL(C.MONTH_OUTPUT_FCST,0) + NVL(B.OQC_MTD,0) - A.OUTPUT_PLAN OUTPUT_DIFF FROM REVENUE_INFO A LEFT JOIN OQC_MTD_WIP B ON A.PRODG1 = B.PRODG1 AND A.LINE = B.LINE LEFT JOIN QTY_FCST_INFO C ON A.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 AND A.LINE = C.LINE )) ,REVENUE_DIFF_INFO AS( SELECT LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,PRODG1,FCST_DAY,HOLD_TIME FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,PRODG1,FCST_DAY,WIP_ACC,HOLD_TIME ,LEAD(WIP_ACC)OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY RN ) FLAG FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,WAFER_QTY,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,LOCATION_,PRODG1,FCST_DAY,REVENUE_DIFF,RN ,ROUND((SYSDATE-LAST_CLAIM_TIME) * 24,1)HOLD_TIME ,SUM(WAFER_QTY)OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY RN DESC) + REVENUE_DIFF WIP_ACC FROM( SELECT A.*,B.FCST_DAY,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.REVENUE_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYYMMDD')REVENUE_DATE ,D.REVENUE_DIFF ,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY B.FCST_DAY DESC,DECODE(A.LOCATION_,'WP',1,2),DECODE(E.OPE_SEQ,NULL,1,2),E.OPE_SEQ)RN FROM ( SELECT A.*,B.PRODG1 FROM INLINE_WIP A LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID ) A LEFT JOIN PWEB.A3_LOT_PRIORITY B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID JOIN REVENUE_SUMMARY_INFO D ON A.PRODG1 = D.PRODG1 AND A.LINE = D.LINE LEFT JOIN PWEB.OPE_NO_INLINE_FLOW_PSTD E ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = E.PRODSPEC_ID AND A.OPE_NO = E.OPE_NO )WHERE FCST_DAY>=REVENUE_DATE) )WHERE NVL(FLAG,0) <= 0 ) ,HOLD_COMMENT AS( SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO,HOLD_USER_ID,CLAIM_TIME ,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY LOT_ID ORDER BY CLAIM_TIME DESC)RN FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO,HOLD_USER_ID,CLAIM_TIME FROM LHN.ODS_HOLD_DETAIL_HISTORY WHERE RELEASE_TIME IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO,HOLD_USER_ID,CLAIM_TIME FROM LHN.ODS_HOLD_DETAIL_HISTORY@TO_A3PDW WHERE RELEASE_TIME IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO,HOLD_USER_ID,CLAIM_DATE_TIME FROM EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT LOT_ID FROM INLINE_WIP )B WHERE A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID ))WHERE RN=1 ) SELECT A.*,B.HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO FROM REVENUE_DIFF_INFO A LEFT JOIN HOLD_COMMENT B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID
